# Skinkpedia

Skinkpedia is an independent educational resource about skinks (family Scincidae), including pet care, species identification, wild skinks, biology and natural history.

## Key sections
- https://skinkpedia.online/skinks/ — skink family overview
- https://skinkpedia.online/pet-skinks/ — pet skink comparison and ownership
- https://skinkpedia.online/skink-care/ — husbandry framework
- https://skinkpedia.online/wild-skinks/north-america/ — North American species and regional identification
- https://skinkpedia.online/skink-biology/ — anatomy, classification and adaptations
- https://skinkpedia.online/editorial-policy/ — editorial standards
- https://skinkpedia.online/sources-research-methodology/ — source methodology

Exact care values are species-specific. Health content is educational and does not replace veterinary care.
